text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! You over there, out of the waaaay!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, sorry, sorry! I have a battle to 
attend to, so I was in a rush!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Then I take my leave!
Onward to the school 
store~!

Was that...
No Reason just now? She seemed 
awfully frantic, but... a battle at the 
school store?

Curious, I decided to drop by the school 
store. When I did, I saw several students 
keeping watch on the sales counter from a 
distance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, the Trainer from before. Might 
thou also be joining the fray?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What,
you know not of it?! 'Tis the Battle 
for the Rainbow Fruit Daifuku! A truly 
grand campaign that no lover of sweets 
dare miss!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
..."Fortune in the heavens, armor on the 
chest, glory upon one's legs." Everyone 
gathered here has prepared to the 
utmost—fierce contenders all eyeing the 
prize of wagashi.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, indeed! Cool, aren't they? The 
words of warlords are rich with meaning. 
True guides for life!
choice_data_list: ...Was that a quote from a warlord...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I stand here fully prepared! 
So that I may claim that great prize
known 
as the Rainbow Fruit Daifuku with these 
very legs!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
The lady at the store is making her 
move... Here it comes.

text_block_list.name: Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! The 
super-rare, limited-quantity "Rainbow 
Fruit Daifuku" ...is now officially on 
sale~!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:
Fwahaha!
Momentum is everything in battle! 
Move swift as wind, conquer fierce as 
fire!

text_block_list.name: Sweets-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wha... so fast?! What incredible 
momentum...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! First one here~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaa-ha-ha! The exquisite "Rainbow Fruit 
Daifuku" has been claimed by meee~!

text_block_list.name: Sweets-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was aiming for that one...
Get out of my 
way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hah, naive! As immovable as the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Sweets-Loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Wha... I got deflected instead?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How's that?
Have you learned your lesson?! 
My battle tactics have no openings 
whatsoever!

It makes the tea
